Yours. Fact: at 0e2935c G19 is NOT broken down anywhere the board can see. git grep finds no 'G19' in any file (only in commit messages), no *Pending.js declarations, and no edges.js entries; it's prose in PUBLIC-APP-SERVER.md. A breakdown to start from, each with what it waits on:
 a) server jobs get SPIRIT_JOB_ID + SPIRIT_CALLBACK_URL (the process contract). Waits on nothing.
 b) the node starts a manifest-declared server app that is NOT a faceServer, kept running. Waits on a.
 c) the api verb: introspection, consent (contacts + the app's list), dispatch over the pipe. Introspection can go first; dispatch waits on b.
 d) grantFace: grants.json keyed by face domain; answers grant and route. Waits on b, c.
 e) the contact sync by owner command, retrying an unseen member after the roll. Waits on d (the face already carries 'contact', e1e9fd8).
 f) the face asks grantFace via api on a cache miss, and appFaceApp's owner half goes. Waits on c, d.
 g) the member client (a shell app). Waits on c, d, e.
 h) the closing test, my three-node run end to end. Waits on all.
